controls.name: base
controls.description: Historical base: exact-match lookups at all three sites.

controls.name: lifecycle-only
controls.description: Strips the base plan only where purchases and renewals resolve their plan.

controls.name: missing-row-check-forgotten
controls.description: Fixes grants and plan changes but not the permanent-missing-row decision.

controls.name: keeps-base-plan-part
controls.description: Splits on the separator but keeps the base-plan part instead of the subscription id.

controls.name: repository-normalizes
controls.description: Legitimate alternative: the repository lookup drops the base plan for every caller.

controls.name: sql-split-part
controls.description: Legitimate alternative: the repository compares against split_part of the incoming id in SQL.

controls.name: normalize-at-entry
controls.description: Legitimate alternative: the webhook entry point rewrites product ids before dispatch.

mutations.repository-normalizes:
--- base/src/agency/api/repositories/subscription_repository.py
+++ repository-normalizes/src/agency/api/repositories/subscription_repository.py
@@ -480,7 +480,8 @@
 
     def get_plan_by_play_product_id(self, play_product_id: str) -> Plan | None:
         """Resolve a Play subscription product to its plan, or None if unmapped."""
-        return self.db.query(Plan).filter(Plan.play_product_id == play_product_id).one_or_none()
+        subscription_id = play_product_id.split(":", 1)[0] if play_product_id else play_product_id
+        return self.db.query(Plan).filter(Plan.play_product_id == subscription_id).one_or_none()
 
     def get_subscription_by_provider_id(self, provider: str, provider_subscription_id: str) -> UserSubscription | None:
         """Get a subscription by its provider-native id."""
mutations.sql-split-part:
--- base/src/agency/api/repositories/subscription_repository.py
+++ sql-split-part/src/agency/api/repositories/subscription_repository.py
@@ -480,7 +480,11 @@
 
     def get_plan_by_play_product_id(self, play_product_id: str) -> Plan | None:
         """Resolve a Play subscription product to its plan, or None if unmapped."""
-        return self.db.query(Plan).filter(Plan.play_product_id == play_product_id).one_or_none()
+        return (
+            self.db.query(Plan)
+            .filter(Plan.play_product_id == func.split_part(play_product_id, ":", 1))
+            .one_or_none()
+        )
 
     def get_subscription_by_provider_id(self, provider: str, provider_subscription_id: str) -> UserSubscription | None:
         """Get a subscription by its provider-native id."""
mutations.normalize-at-entry:
--- base/src/agency/api/services/revenuecat_service.py
+++ normalize-at-entry/src/agency/api/services/revenuecat_service.py
@@ -42,6 +42,14 @@
         """Process one webhook event. Raises on failures that should retry (500)."""
         event_type = event.get("type", "unknown")
         event_id = event.get("id", "unknown")
+        event = {
+            **event,
+            **{
+                key: event[key].split(":", 1)[0]
+                for key in ("product_id", "new_product_id")
+                if isinstance(event.get(key), str)
+            },
+        }
 
         # A SANDBOX event must never touch production state — enforced in code,
         # not dashboard convention (the dev/prod webhook trap from the PRD).
